# PR 267 correctness review, round 1 of 2

Head: eb5392555c017177d984844d558c89d15e5c83ad
Base: e4b63eb1b2834951b8927ee36925217d5566c97b
Verdict: PASS WITH NOTES. No blocking correctness findings.

## Assessment

- **Directional brake:** `registration.rs:741-781` only adds an early refusal for a verified descendant of an active local holder on the same pane. It runs before mutation (`:956-958`). Same-process and same-conversation exclusions preserve the previous path; the exemption does not grant registration or bypass the subsequent native, collision, supersedes, retirement, or reclaim checks. Removing the new refusal admits the same claims or more, not fewer.
- **Copied session:** yes, a same-user child deliberately naming the holder's `harness_session` passes this brake. Existing native continuity can then resume that address; the string is not an authenticity proof. This is not new authority relative to the baseline. C33 explicitly trusts same-user processes and retains correctness guards against accidental misattribution, not per-seat isolation. Ordinary one-shot runtime sessions are distinct; the existing shell `pij send` path intentionally acts as the enclosing seat.
- **Normal continuity:** `/new` in the same process bypasses the descendant check by exact process identity. Same-conversation Copilot restarts bypass only this brake, including the first restart below the still-live initial CLI. Later sibling restarts retain the existing continuity path. Revive prebinds have no previous process; confirmed-dead/recycled holders do not trigger this refusal. Reclaim retains its existing authority/death checks. Interactive Claude resume keeps adoption and daemon-derived conversation verification.
- **OMP/pi:** `core/discovery.ts:95-97` excludes print/json, not tui/rpc. `index.ts:427,569,606` suppresses registration, FYI claims, and shutdown; all three mutating peer tools call the same context guard (`:196,361,407`). Existing in-process subagent exclusion remains.
- **Claude:** `claude-session-start-pij.sh:24-30` exits before ping, adoption, or retry setup for SDK entrypoints, while cli/unset retain previous behavior. The case value and log argument are quoted and not evaluated as shell code. The regression checks sdk-cli/sdk-ts/sdk-py versus cli/unset. No private identity, content, or out-of-layout machine path found in the changed docs.
- **Cost:** no new background loop, poll, timer, or process launch. There is a new bounded ancestry loop (`registration.rs:788-800`): at most 64 in-process reads per relevant local co-pane row per registration, zero when idle. The parent reader uses the existing in-process macOS/Linux implementation.

## Evidence

Read-only review of all 11 changed files and the dependent registration/adoption/session-selection paths. Product worktree remained clean at the requested SHA.

- `just pr-freeze 267`: PASS, FINAL at the exact head, checked twice.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`: PASS.
- `/bin/sh -n harness/scripts/claude-session-start-pij.sh`: PASS.
- CI run 44491161665, attempt 1: SUCCESS at the exact head. Rust job 135446824638: `cargo nextest run --locked --workspace --profile ci`, 2,579 passed, 6 skipped.
- Downloaded JUnit artifact **14513316253**, selected from that successful job's upload log, by ID. Confirmed PASS, not skipped: F197 child refusal/unchanged-holder regression; sibling restarts; opted-out restart; revived launch; owner-close reclaim; native reconnect/explicit-new-session; fast restart; first-prompt session handoff; Claude one-shot SessionStart regression.
- CI check (22), job 135446824724: `.omp/extensions/pij/index.test.ts`, all 18 passed; full Vitest result 2,352 passed, 7 skipped. Check (24), rust-lint, and delivers also passed.

No cargo, builds, dependency installs, or local TS runners were invoked. Boot/full harness checks would build and were not run under the explicit no-build reviewer contract. C25 also keeps TS proof CI-only in this dependency-free checkout. Coder mutation claims were inspected for relevance, not independently rerun.

## Non-blocking operational note

Retain the PR's planned live proof after merge/bounce: an OMP print child and a Copilot print child leave no new seat or changed holder; two Copilot restarts still register and retain their carried route. In particular, actual Copilot print-session uniqueness remains a live-runtime check, not something the injected unit fixtures prove.

## Harness feedback

magicWand: a read-only review-evidence command combining pr-freeze, exact-head successful CI jobs, and artifact-ID-based scoped JUnit results, without builds or dependencies.

difficulties: build-backed boot/checks are incompatible with read-only reviewer admission; CI evidence extraction currently requires several manual commands. Captured as harness observation MW-001. No product-code or shared governance-ledger edits made by this review.
